description: Look up an ERC-8004 agent by token id on Base, slug, wallet address (0x...) or the name it declares. Returns whether it is ranked, its liveness level (L0-L9), bound wallet, stablecoin float, payment totals and open incidents. Up to 25 ids at once, separated by commas. A name is matched among ranked agents only, and a declared name is the agent's own claim, not verified.

query.description: Token id (57657), slug (8004-base-57657), wallet (0x...), a declared name, or up to 25 ids separated by commas

name: find_agent
title: Find an agent
